statement: From [8] a family of implementations of Hopcroft’s state minimization algorithm are always faster than Moore’s algorithm. The result follows from Corollary 4. In [5] the lower bound on the algorithm is proved to be O(n log n) for any implementation. Though it is still unknown whether there exists an implementation whose average complexity is Θ(n).
context: I Corollary 5. For the uniform distribution on complete deterministic accessible automata, there exists a family of implementations of Hopcroft’s state minimization algorithm whose average complexity is O(n log log n). From [8] a family of implementations of Hopcroft’s state minimization algorithm are always faster than Moore’s algorithm. The result follows from Corollary 4. In [5] the lower bound on the algorithm is proved to be O(n log n) for any implementation. Though it is still unknown whether there exists an implementation whose average complexity is Θ(n).
